description: OpenStreetMap node/8694916269. Named in OpenStreetMap as the memorial sign to the death of flying instructor A. B. Kolevatov on 1 August 1983 — an accident memorial at the former Chernihiv flying school's practice field. NO AIRCRAFT TYPE IS RECORDED so the object is Unidentified; it may be a memorial stone with a propeller rather than an airframe and needs a photograph
